title: Lower Waiehu Beach Road land purchase and title dispute
summary: On June 5, 2026, the council voted 9–0 to file, or set aside, Bill 102, which would have funded buying a Wailuku property. Before that, the chair said in May that the church may put the land on the open market if the County does not act. The administration wants to buy the land and keep it as open space, though a testifier said the church selling it has no title.
